description: Source code for inline element parsing in the Blackfriday Markdown processor, including functions for emphasis, code spans, links, autolinks, and HTML comments.

methods.name: inline
methods.description: Parses inline markdown elements within a block, handling emphasis, links, code spans, etc.

methods.name: codeSpan
methods.description: Parses inline code spans enclosed in backticks.

methods.name: maybeLineBreak
methods.description: Detects a line break preceded by two spaces.

methods.name: lineBreak
methods.description: Handles hard line breaks if extension enabled.

methods.name: maybeAutoLink
methods.description: Detects autolinks starting with protocols like http, https, ftp, mailto.

methods.name: autoLink
methods.description: Creates a link node from autolink text.

methods.name: tagLength
methods.description: Determines if a string starts with an HTML tag or autolink.

methods.name: isMailtoAutoLink
methods.description: Checks if data matches a mailto autolink pattern.

methods.name: helperFindEmphChar
methods.description: Finds the position of emphasis characters, skipping other constructs.

methods.name: helperEmphasis
methods.description: Parses emphasis syntax with one or more asterisks or tildes.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Creates a text node with given content.
